title: Another great Reynolds' product. Kudos!!!
text: Another great Reynolds' product. Kudos!!!. As I have said in other reviews, I absolutely love Reynolds products. They always have the chef in mind for easing cooking and clean up needs. These bags are no exception. They are large (can accommodate a small baking chicken) and tough (won't break on it's own. I used these for pork chops last night and filled the bag with onions and seasoning, popped it into the oven for 50 minutes and, yum, cooked to perfection. Clean up was minimal, just a rinse of the pan in the sink and I was good to go. Every kitchen should have a supply of these for every day needs.

description: Make moist, delicious meals with Reynolds Kitchens Oven Bags, and save time on cleanup. Enjoy great-tasting, single-pan meals in the oven and skip the time you'd spend soaking and scrubbing your pan. These disposable roasting bags help seal in the natural juices of poultry, meat and vegetables while cooking, to keep each and every meal tender and delicious. Each bag is BPA-free, oven-safe up to 400 degrees Fahrenheit and can hold up to eight pounds of your heartiest meals, from risotto to whole ham. Spend more time with your loved ones and less time scrubbing with Reynolds Kitchens Oven Bags.
